book.name: 1 Kolinita
book.title: 1 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta ꞌaigeda Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Keliso ꞌina toholo hila weyahina

Ciyagwao, tetelaina yahepwaila pwaiyeya ꞌoimiya, wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega mwalo ꞌatemi watagwaleya tetelaina ꞌoina, ma ꞌiꞌabihe paꞌaligomiya ta ꞌoinega ꞌami ꞌabihetena walobeya, ꞌeguma tetelina waꞌabiyahiya. Ta ꞌeguma geya waꞌabiyahi paꞌalina, ꞌimi hemisaowedi gide ginaula bwagabwaga.
Tetelaina lamuna yaꞌita lobeya ꞌoinega yahepwaile ꞌoimiya ꞌabehega Keliso ꞌida puiyao weyahidi ꞌiꞌamasa, gidemusa Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina hepwaila,
ta galiha silaguya, ma sabwelo hetoina ꞌoina ꞌitoholo hila, gidemusa Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌihepwaila ꞌesa.
Citoholo hila ma Pita ꞌiꞌiteya ta wete ꞌana tohepwailao site tuwelo siꞌiteya.
Caigeda tuta ꞌoina ꞌiyadao wete site paibi handeledi siꞌiteya. Bodaedi ꞌoidiyega baibaiwadi bewa tuwa simiyamiya, ma tupwadi siꞌamasa.
Yemesa wete ꞌiꞌiteya, ta wete Keliso ꞌana tohepwailao mabwaiyadi siꞌiteya.
Ta ꞌebe losaloha taugu wete yaꞌiteya, ma hesi taugu ꞌigu tole ꞌebe henainaida, geya gidemusa taudi ꞌidi tuta silobeya ta sitoleya.
Ta wete taugu loheya galagu. Weyahina Yehoba ꞌana tohemisao yaꞌabihe muyemuyediya, ꞌoinega Keliso ꞌana tohepwailao mabwaiyadi sibwebweꞌana sinegauwa.

Ma hesi Yehoba ꞌiꞌatemuya muyaegauwa ta ꞌilemegauwa. Coinega geya ꞌiꞌabihete daidaisigau, weyahina yahemisa bwaibwaina ma tohepwailao mabwaiyadi ꞌidi paihowa yaꞌebesineya, geya taugu ꞌigu waiwaiyega, ta Yehoba ꞌina helau ꞌoinega.
Coinega tohepwailaedi ꞌoimiya siloguguya pwaiya, ma taugu wete ꞌoimiya yaloguguya pwaiya, ta Keliso wahemiseya.
Toholo hila weyahina
Cima guguya ꞌoimiya ꞌahepwaileya ꞌabehega Keliso ꞌamasega ꞌitoholo hila, ta wahemiseya. Ma toꞌaha weyahina tupwami wagwae ꞌabehega tomota geya sawasawahidi ma ꞌamasega sitoholo hilama?
Weyahina ꞌeguma tomota sahena ꞌamasega sitotoholo hila, Keliso wete ꞌamasega gesowana ꞌitoholo hila.
Coinega ꞌima loguguyaedi tuwa ginaula bwagabwaga, eeta ꞌimi hemisaina Keliso ꞌoina beno hemisa bwagabwaga.
Wete tauma Yehoba ꞌana tohepwailao ꞌaꞌabowegomiya ꞌima gwaeyedi ꞌoidiyega, weyahina ꞌagwaeya, “Yehoba Keliso ꞌamasega ꞌiꞌabi hetoholo hileya,” ta toꞌamasaedi geya sida toholo hila.
Coinega Keliso wete gesowana ꞌitoholo hila.
Ta Kelisoina wete wahemisa bwagabwaga, ma ꞌoinega ꞌimi puiyao tuwa ꞌabwa simiyamiya ꞌoimiya.
Ma ꞌiyadaowedi taudi mwalo Keliso sihemisaeya ta siꞌamasa pwaiya, beno taꞌeha simiyamiya?
Ta wete tauda Keliso ꞌana tohepwailao nuwaꞌoleꞌoleda, ꞌeguma Keliso ꞌina ꞌabihetena ꞌoida tuta bewa baleꞌumo weyahina, ta geya tuta ꞌinaonaoma ꞌida ꞌamasa mulina weyahina.
Ta ꞌana dumwalu hesi beno Keliso ꞌamasega ꞌitoholo hila, tauna ꞌihanugeta ma muliyetega toꞌamasao mabwaiyadi.
Weyahina loheya ꞌaigeda tuwa ꞌoinega ꞌamasa ꞌilatuwa baleꞌuwa, beno Adama, ta wete gidemusa loheya ꞌaigeda ꞌina paihowega toholo hila ꞌiꞌabilatuheya.
Tasanapu pwaiya ꞌabehega Adama ꞌina pui ꞌoinega tauda ꞌamasa ꞌoida ꞌilatuwa, ma hesi Keliso ꞌoinega yawasida hataya talobeya.
Ta yawasi hataya ꞌina tauya bewa gidemusa, nugeta Keliso ꞌitoholo hila, ma ꞌabwa tutaina ꞌihilama tauda taiyawedi ꞌina bodao wete tatoholo hila.

Ma muliyetega Kelisoina nata toloinao mabwaiyadi ꞌihewaiwai sinedi gide welabana ma hiꞌahiꞌa ma yaluyaluwa galadi mabwaiyadi ꞌihewaiwai sinedi, ma tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losaloha ꞌoina Keliso ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌiꞌebwae Tamana ꞌoina.
Weyahina Kelisoina nata maꞌina waiwai ꞌiloiloina eema ꞌana siga ꞌana ꞌalehaowedi mabwaiyadi ꞌihewaiwai sinedi,
eeta ꞌana ꞌebe losaloha ꞌamasa ꞌihewaiwaisine ma ꞌigumwala.
Weyahina Yehoba loina mabwaiyana Keliso ꞌiꞌebwaeya. Beno tuwa Keliso gesowana Toꞌebwayaina ꞌiloiloinae.

Coinega ꞌabwa tutaina Keliso ginaula mabwaiyadi ꞌiloinaedi, muliyetega tauna ꞌitagwala Tamana ꞌina loina ꞌoina, weyahina Tamana Keliso ꞌina loina mabwaiyana ꞌana toꞌebwaya, ꞌoinega Yehobaina ꞌihane hedade.
Ta ꞌeguma toꞌamasa sahena sitohotoholo hila, toꞌaha weyahina tomota sibabitaiso toꞌamasao weyahidi?
Ma wete togidega taugu? Ceguma gesowana ꞌamasega yatoholo hila toꞌaha weyahina ꞌebe hesilae ꞌoina tuta mabwaiyana yapaipaihowa Keliso weyahina?
Moisa, sabwelo ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya gide yaꞌamaꞌamasa, ma hesi maꞌigu yaliyaya ꞌomi ꞌimi toholo paꞌala weyahina, ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso ꞌoina.

Ta wete mwalo Epeso ꞌoina loheloheya gamwagamwasowalidi totopwatula gide siloloꞌalehegau, ma hesi loꞌalehaina geya ꞌana bwebweꞌanamo ꞌoiguwa ꞌeguma geya ꞌamasega yatoholo hila! Coinega tupwana tomota sigwae ꞌabehega ꞌilobwainegita ma tuta bewa baleꞌuwa tayaliyaya ꞌida ꞌai ta ꞌida numa ꞌoidiyega, weyahina nata ꞌamasa ꞌana tuta, gesowana ꞌaigeda wete toꞌaha talobaloba.
Ta hesi gwaeyedi beno ꞌabo tuwa, ꞌoinega sahena ꞌoidiyega siꞌabowegomi, tabu ta mumugadi galana waheꞌauꞌaunaowedi.
Nuwana tupwami Yehoba wahenainaideya. Bewa ꞌebe debamwadina ꞌoimiya, ꞌoinega ꞌilobwainegomiya ma wada sanapu, ma mumuga galana walolagu.
Wahi hauhauna
Ma tupwami geya wanuwanuwa sabwalena toholo hila weyahina, ꞌoinega wagwae. “Toꞌamasaedi to ꞌwapi ꞌoinega sitoholo hila?”
Coinega ꞌilobwainegomiya ma wada sanapu ꞌabehega ꞌeguma patu taꞌuma ma ꞌibwala ꞌabwa patuina ꞌimwahulu.
Wasanapuya ꞌabehega ꞌeguma pegapega nuwana ꞌaigeda patu tadauni, ꞌwapina ꞌoinega ꞌibwala, geya patu nugenugetaina ꞌana ꞌita gidemusa, ma hesi hagana,
weyahina toloina tauna Yehoba, ma ꞌaiwe ta pwatula ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌadi ꞌita ꞌina nuwatuhu gidemusa, ta ꞌilagudiya.
Ta wete wahi Yehoba ꞌiloinaeya, tomota wahida hagana ma hagana, hebahebai wahidi hagana, bwasumo wahidi hagana, ma silahana wete wahidi hagana.
Ta wete megalewa wahidi hagana ma gogo gabulena wahida hagana, wete ꞌadi ꞌebe hepwatu hagana tauda ꞌoidega.
Ta wete hala ꞌana hepwatu hagana, ma waiꞌena ꞌana hepwatu hagana, ma ꞌipwala wete ꞌadi hepwatu hagana ma hagana.
Cida toholo hila wete gidemusa, wahida mwahumwahuludi sigaligalihedi, ma ꞌabwa ꞌeguma tatoholo hila wahida gesowana simwahumwahulu.
Moisa, wahida ꞌebe debamwadina ma weꞌaweꞌaidi sigaligalihedi ma ꞌiyamo wahida galewa tatotoholo hila, ma wahidaedi maꞌadi hepwatu ta waiwaidi,
weyahina wahi baleꞌuwa sigaligalihedi ta wahi galewa sitotoholo hila, weyahina wahi baleꞌu hagana ma wahi galewa hagana.
Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina hepwaila wete gidemusa ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Loheya nugenugetaina, Adama wahina mayawasina; ma loheya heluwena yaluyaluwana ꞌoinega sowasowana yawasida ꞌiꞌebwaegita.”

content: Loheya yaluyaluwana geya ꞌilatu nugeta, ma hesi wahida ꞌihapwesa nugeta ma yaluyaluwa muliyetega.
Weyahina loheya nugenugetana Yehoba ꞌipaihoweya baleꞌu ꞌoinega, ta loheya heluwena galewega ꞌisuluma.
Mabwaiyada Adama tubunao baleꞌuwa tamiyamiya, ꞌada ꞌita mebaleꞌu gidemusa, ma wete wahida hauhaudi galewega ꞌabwa taꞌewadi, ꞌadi ꞌita gidemusa Keliso wahina hauhauna.
Ciyagwao wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega wahida baleꞌuwa ꞌimwahumwahulu gesowana ꞌiluhu galewa, weyahina wahi baleꞌuwa mwahuluna, ta wahi galewa geya ꞌida mwahuluwa.
Ma wete sanapu hauhauna yaheꞌitegomi ꞌabehega gesowana tohekalesiyao mabwaiyada taꞌamaꞌamasa, ma hesi tupwada ꞌabwa mayawasida tamiyamiya ma Yehoba wahida ꞌida buidi.
Weyahina tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losaloha ꞌoina yoguli ꞌida muꞌa madouna, ma Yehoba wahida ꞌida bui mwayamwayauwedi, ma wete toꞌamasao mawahi hauhaudi sitoholo hila, ta tauda mayawasida wahida wete ꞌibuidi.
Weyahina Yehoba sawasawahina wahi mwahumwahuludi ma ꞌamaꞌamasidi ꞌibuidi ma siꞌehau ta miyamiya hatayadi.
Ma ꞌabwa tuta nage ꞌoina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌana ꞌahwa moisa ꞌilatu, beno ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Tauna ꞌabwa ꞌihewaiwai moisa ma ꞌamasa ꞌigumwala.
Weyahina gesowana ꞌamasa ꞌihehewaiwai, ma hesi ꞌamasa ꞌina gala ꞌoida ꞌigumwala.”

content: Camasaina ꞌina waiwai ꞌilatuwa mumuga galana ꞌoinega, eeta mumuga galagala ꞌina waiwai beno Mosese ꞌina loinao ꞌadi ligeha ꞌoidiyega.
Ma hesi ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso ꞌiꞌabihetegita ma galanaina ꞌoinega tahewaiwaisine, eeta Yehoba ꞌoina taloyauwedo madouna.
Ma wete ꞌiyagwao yaloyauwedo madouna ꞌoimiya ta yaguguyegomi ma watoholo paꞌala ma tuta mabwaiyana wada hetapewa Bada ꞌina paihowa ꞌoina, weyahina ꞌabwa Bada ꞌina paihowaina ꞌoinega huwaina taloba.
